body.intent: Fix the ship-change ci-triage step can't read RSpec failures: on nebari#72 (run 01M6T4EH) one RSpec example failed (rspec ./spec/views/tasks/list_spec.rb:290, '1 failure' in the job log) but ci-triage ended 'no failing test was recorded for the head: an infra or unparsable failure' and failed the run, so a Rails project's red CI never reaches ci-fix; ci-triage must parse RSpec's 'Failed examples:' / 'rspec ./path:line' lines (and other common runners' output) as failing tests
